traits.zh: 提供具人文故事的小批量咖啡豆与限定特饮
traits.en: Offers story-driven small-batch beans and limited-edition drinks

traits.zh: 供应铸铁锅浓汤配溏心蛋与烤面包片
traits.en: Serves green soup in cast-iron pot with soft-boiled eggs and toast

traits.zh: 临街落地玻璃窗，可览街道与行人
traits.en: Floor-to-ceiling windows facing the street with views of pedestrians

traits.zh: 营业至凌晨0点（周五至周六）
traits.en: Closes at 00:00 on Fridays and Saturdays

traits.zh: 设有巨型铜罐，招牌为氮气风味飞行品鉴
traits.en: Features a massive copper cask; signature is Nitro flight

focus.zh: 营业时间长但非办公区
focus.en: Long hours but not for work

linger.zh: 有餐食与特色饮品，适合停留
linger.en: Food and unique drinks encourage lingering
